name: usage-ledger-prototype-pollution-hardening
title: Systematically harden the usage ledger against Object.prototype pollution via a single null-proto whitelist chokepoint (+ residual in-operator belt)
description: Generalize B-30c3 own-prop/null-proto hardening from the codex/gemini provider extractors to the rest of the usage ledger. Add one null-prototype whitelist chokepoint helper applied at extractRawUsage (assemble.ts) + the anthropic extract (dispatch-usage.ts) so downstream adapter/streaming reads are safe by construction, plus convert residual in-operators (record.ts, openai/shared adapters, streaming.ts) to own-property checks. Defense-in-depth + consistency (NO live vuln). Spec: docs/requirements/decisions/usage-ledger-prototype-pollution-hardening.md. + prototype-pollution smoke. NON-GOALS: B-253e validator, four-field accounting, record shapes, codex/gemini extractors (already done).
